name: Demiparadoxia ∞ Hookerstic - Nanka Hen

source:
Main character finds an inn at a snow mountains. The maid here has a gorgeous body and no recollection that her true identity is Miss Sophia, a former luxury widow.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在雪山中发现了一家旅店。这里的女仆身材姣好，却不记得自己的真实身份其实是索菲亚夫人——一位昔日生活奢华的寡妇。
